item.title: How did @tabbygirlroo learn to "talk" with buttons? Roo's guardian Alana gives us her perspective on training with Roo, who has learned over 24 FluentPet buttons since January of this year! There's an almost hour-long conversation available on YouTube - we dive deeper into these topics, share more tips & tricks, as well as a few funny stories. Check out the link in my stories for the full interview!
